description: A shell script primarily used for testing Git workflows related to pull requests, including setup, pushing, and formatting of pull requests in various scenarios.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, with a description and a set of commands.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the git internal clock for testing purposes.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Asserts that the given command exits with a failure status.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files or output streams for equality.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test suite.
